name: Focus Home Interactive Societe anonyme
summary: Focus Home Interactive Société Anonyme publishes and distributes games worldwide. It offers games for various platforms and consoles, such as PS4, XBOX ONE, PS3, XBOX 360, MAC, NINTENDO DS/3DS, PS VITA/PSP, IPHONE/IPAD, and LINUX, as well as for use in PCs. The company distributes its titles through stores, as well as through the downloading platforms. Focus Home Interactive Société Anonyme was founded in 1996 and is based in Paris, France.
